details: European Central Bank (ECB) policymakers have indicated a potential interest rate increase as early as June, following their decision to keep rates unchanged on Thursday. This stance comes amid growing concerns about a deteriorating inflation outlook, primarily driven by surging energy prices and ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Policymakers fear that high price growth could become entrenched, leading to calls for tighter monetary policy. Money markets are currently pricing in a 75% probability of an ECB rate hike in June.
title: ECB Policymakers Signal June Rate Hike Amid Stubborn Inflation
